content:
Activities are a sub-set of quests in *Fallout 76*; with *The Backwoods* update in 2026, smaller events were renamed to activities, while public events maintained their pre-existing terminology. Activities are shared quests that spawn around the world and are only available to be completed for a limited amount of time before they despawn and go back on cooldown. Every 10 minutes, a random event will become available. Activities will not repeat until they have all been completed.

Any player character can participate in these event quests, regardless of level, and some event quests encourage player characters to team up to complete the objective. These quests are displayed under the section "DAILY" of the Pip-Boy.

All activities give the following rewards:

These activities are available to all players (including Enclave activities, even if a player character has not completed their faction quest line) and randomly appear in the game world every 10 minutes; they do not refresh until completed. There are a few exceptions: Powering Up is only started by approaching one of the relevant locations, which become available on a fresh server or eight real-life hours after the last repair was completed; Riding Shotgun is started by talking to Vinny Costa and can be repeated every 20 minutes.
